items.detail: 2027: revenue +5.2%; 2028: revenue +5.2%, operating profit +13.8%; 2029: revenue +5.2%, operating profit +14.0%; 2030: revenue +5.2%, operating profit +14.1%; 2031: revenue +5.2%, operating profit +14.1%; 2032: revenue +5.2%, operating profit +14.1%; 2033: revenue +5.2%, operating profit +14.1%; the growth rate is unchanged in [2028, 2029, 2030, 2031, 2032, 2033] while the level moved; answered: Level change stated: FY28 base revenue 226,560 -> 238,360 (+5.2%) only because rev0 rose with the FY27 guide (192,000 -> 202,000); growth rates are unchanged in every year, so the +5.2% level carries into FY29-FY33; operating profit +19.2% to +19.6% each year (FY28 22,203 -> 26,458) because the margin path rose 1.3 points with the FY27 guide-implied margin (10.3% -> 11.6%).

confirmed: No one-off revenue: the Q3 release names none (products 48,925 + services 6,012 = 54,937; no partnership, settlement or extra-week revenue), so rev0 = the FY27 guide midpoint 202,000 with nothing taken out. Receivables read against deferred revenue: AR 22,918 -> 28,948 (+6.0B, +26% q/q against revenue +17%; DSO ~45 -> ~48 days) while deferred revenue rose 29,718 -> 32,851 (+3.1B); AR is not running far ahead of billing, but the Q3 working-capital build (AR + inventory - AP from -5.5B to +0.6B) is a cash-conversion watch item, already in the base-year net cash. items.detail: confirmed: Yes: the bear is an AI-capex digestion with an inventory hit: FY28 +8%, FY29 -12%, margins 9.0% then 7.5% (the pre-AI level, 2.6 points under the FY27 guide-implied 11.6%, which also covers the memory-cost read-across from HPE's Q4: non-GAAP GM -220bps q/q), exit P/E 8, and an FY29 after-tax inventory/purchase-commitment charge raised 1,600 -> 1,800 because inventory rose 21,290 -> 29,444 (+38% q/q, days ~52 -> ~62) against purchase obligations of 34.8B at 31.7 (Q3 figure unknown until the 10-Q). Not separately modelled: DFS credit losses (receivables 20.9B, originations +111%) and customer concentration (10-Q gap). Bear 5-year return +2.9% a year, far from the -10% leg. (evidence: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1571996/000157199626000050/exhibit991earnings8kq3fy27.htm; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1571996/000157199626000046/dell-20260731.htm; runs/tickers/DELL_2026-11-25/ex991_q3fy27.txt)
